summary: Code structure is sound (proper error handling, strict mode, pinned versions, least-privilege perms) but deliverable is incomplete. Workflow references tests/unit and fixtures directories without validation — steps will fail silently if missing. Critical gaps: (1) Workflow not validated with actionlint (required); (2) Workflow not tested with act (required); (3) Fixture files missing (required by task). Markdown table headers repeat; module import error handling opaque. Not production-ready.
